description: 嘉義市iTaiwan WiFi無線網路熱點 [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 嘉義市政府. 本項資料提供嘉義市境內各機關建置的iTaiwan WiFi無線網路熱點位置。 主要場所包含各地旅遊景點、交通運輸節點、文教館所、申辦洽公場所等室內公共空間，以利民眾洽公、臨時急需時可上網查閱相關資訊。. Coverage: Chiayi City. The portal files it under the publisher 嘉義市政府. Its tags are 交通及通訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-04-24 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
